title: Planet Tweaks V3.5.4 - Native C++20 KeyEngine, Live AMD/NVIDIA GPU & Dynamic CPU Telemetry, Reconnected Supabase Google Sign-In
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.5.4 (2026-11-23): (1) Native C++20 Keyboard Engine (PlanetTweaks.KeyEngine.exe): Zero-GC Win32 WH_KEYBOARD_LL sidecar compiled with pinned Zig 0.17.1, PowerToys-exact wVk+wScan SendInput injection, modifier-to-non-modifier state repair (LAlt->R without stuck Alt/WM_SYSKEYDOWN), gated native recovery ownership (zero split-brain), pause-while-held tombstones, SnapTap foreground-transition cleanup, and automatic managed fallback. (2) Live Hardware Telemetry Overhaul: Pure user-mode AMD ADL2 & NVIDIA NVML GPU temperature providers (Spec Switcher proof, trusted absolute System32/NVSMI DLL paths), 10-sample rolling dynamic CPU thermal zone selector rejecting frozen BIOS zones, non-blocking startup, 1s background PeriodicTimer polling, complete immutable HardwareSnapshot UI binding, and decimal utilization precision. (3) Reconnected Supabase & Google Sign-In: Migrated to live Supabase project with server-side /auth/v1/user token verification, live Privacy Policy & Terms of Service pages, and honest performance copy across app & website.
